evidence.quote: **Bring-your-own-key**: the plugin is free and open source; remote model providers require your own API keys.
SiliconFlow, Ollama, LM Studio, and other profiles from one settings page

checkNote: The default MiniMax profile has an empty key, but the README offers Ollama and LM Studio profiles from the same settings page, with a local default of http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 in the code. The summary feature works keyless with a local model, and only remote providers 'require your own API keys'.
